1.en_consolidated_definition:
To lobby or petition persistently and often in a formal manner, especially to influence the decision of an official or politician, typically through repeated visits or communications.

Nota: En el contexto de Puerto Rico, "cabildear" se refiere a la práctica de visitar repetidamente a funcionarios o políticos para influir en sus decisiones.
